title: The epic-reconciler release flake extends to a THIRD test and fails 21% of single-file runs (extends drafted finding 5677ed059474abe9)
body: In 24 fresh runs of npx vitest run test/epic-reconciler.test.ts, 5 failed (21%), and besides the two tests already named in drafted finding 5677ed059474abe9092e54d80dd029c47909e673570e44477896cf431cfbf8dd, a third test is affected: 'refuses to run a second Workflow that cannot take the publish slot, and writes nothing'. Captured assertion (epic-reconciler.test.ts:2283): room.slotStatus() expected null, received the slot still held with expires_at ~62s in the future — the tests poll the terminal CHECKPOINT then read the room immediately, racing the post-terminal release steps at epic-reconciler.ts:1708-1733 (the ox0 shape). Triage should merge this with the drafted finding: a tree gate that runs this file fails innocent trees roughly one run in five.
